create.name: Alex Halenda
create.bio:
Alex Halenda grew up in Miami in a devout Christian family, was homeschooled for much of her childhood and spent long, quiet stretches outdoors. At fifteen she persuaded a Buddhist teacher at her high school to lead a meditation session, and the crowd that turned up became a school meditation club. Yoga followed, and she has now taught for about sixteen years, with training in Ashtanga, power and yin styles, study of yoga and psychology, and a year of yoga and service at Mount Madonna Center in the community founded by Baba Hari Das.

She is based in Los Angeles, where Kinship Yoga in Highland Park is her home studio. She teaches around ten classes a week, mostly heated vinyasa and hatha with some yin, and also leads sessions on breathwork, mantra and inversions and part of the studio's 200-hour teacher training. Her classes are known for clear cueing, humour and careful options for every level, and she likes to pair physical effort with a question to contemplate. She shares free full-length classes on YouTube, sells recorded practices as audio downloads, and leads retreats, including a week at Esalen on lila, the idea of life as divine play.

courses.title: Finding Lila Through Yoga and Divine Play
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen in Big Sur, co-led with Jet Eveleth, built on the Hindu idea of lila or divine play. Mornings open with yoga and breathwork, middays bring body-awareness exercises and playful group games, and evenings close with yoga nidra and meditation. All levels are welcome.

courses.title: Studio Classes in Los Angeles
courses.description: Her weekly public classes, mostly heated vinyasa and hatha with some yin, taught at Kinship Yoga in Highland Park and listed on her studio schedule page. Classes are all levels and combine movement, breath and a short meditation.

courses.title: Everyday Yin Yoga (MP3)
courses.description: A 70-minute yin class as an audio file, guided by her voice so you can practise at home without a screen. It moves through long floor holds such as thread the needle and half pigeon, using two blocks or pillows and a strap.

courses.title: Basic Yoga Flow (MP3)
courses.description: An hour-long, all-levels flow class as an audio recording, for students comfortable following spoken cues without a video. It is paced to be repeatable as a daily practice.

courses.title: 20 Minute Every Day Flow (MP3)
courses.description: A gentle twenty-minute audio flow that works as a warm-up or a cool-down on its own. Suitable for all levels; blocks are optional.

courses.title: Custom Audio File
courses.description: A recorded practice made to order: after buying, you email her what you would like and she records a session shaped around it.

free_resources.title: Yoga with Alex: Free Classes on YouTube
free_resources.description: A page on her site gathering her full-length recorded classes, from gentle vinyasa and yin to sweatier flows. Free to use, with an optional donation.
